steps.title: The episode reaches its success condition.
steps.code:
import primitive_api as api

def step(line):
    r = api.execute_program_step(line)
    print(line, "->", r.get("valid_action"), str(r.get("error"))[:150])
    return r.get("valid_action")

step("[WALK] <home_office> (241)")
step("[WALK] <phone> (1000)")
v = api.validate_program_step("[GRAB] <phone> (1000)")
print("validate GRAB 1000:", v.get("valid_action"), str(v.get("error"))[:150])
if v.get("valid_action"):
    step("[GRAB] <phone> (1000)")
print("SUCCESS:", api.check_activity_success())
if not api.check_activity_success().get("success"):
    print("EXEC phone now:", api.list_executable_actions(query="phone", limit=20))
    ex = api.explain_action_preconditions("[GRAB] <phone> (2045)")
    crs = ex.get("current_relevant_state", {}) or {}
    print("2045 ctx:", ex.get("valid_action"), [e for e in crs.get("edges", []) if e["relation"] != "CLOSE"][:10])
